title: Rate-Type Eligibility Chain Repair

motivation.issue: PATCH_RT_METRIC_BRIDGE_RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBILITY_001 remained blocked because PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_061 was active in runtime decisions but still recorded as PROPOSED in the patch registry.
motivation.audit_result: The chain block is a status-reconciliation mismatch, not a missing conceptual dependency.
motivation.conclusion: Synchronize the upstream witness status to APPLIED and record the repair explicitly.

decision.registry_fix: Update PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_061.json to APPLIED with a recorded applied_on timestamp.
decision.chain_effect: PATCH_RT_METRIC_BRIDGE_RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBILITY_001 becomes chain-satisfied once the refreshed registry is read.
decision.downstream_scope: PATCH_RT_METRIC_BRIDGE_RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBILITY_TESTS_002 remains separate and still depends on the eligibility predicate.

implementation: Synchronize the bridge-admissibility witness status in registry/governance/patches/PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_061.json.
Refresh registry/governance_hash_registry.json for the touched governance surfaces.

required_repo_changes.description: Synchronize the upstream witness status to APPLIED and record an applied_on timestamp.
Record the dependency-chain repair diagnosis and verification trace.
Add the governed chain-repair clarification and lexicon entry.
Register the repair event in the governance ledger.
Refresh hashes for the touched governance surfaces.

acceptance_criteria: patch-chain for PATCH_RT_METRIC_BRIDGE_RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBILITY_TESTS_002 no longer inherits the upstream block from PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_061.
notes: The repair changes registry state only.
The repair does not promote the bridge claim.
The repair does not modify RT_core.
